title: Double Drip Crystal Mist E-Liquid 10ml
description: Crystal Mist e-liquid by Double Drip is a scrumptious blend of fresh blue raspberry mixed with juicy black cherries, and a dash of menthol, reminiscent of cool refreshing slush. Double Drip Coil Sauce E-Liquid is a high-quality vape juice brand proudly manufactured right here in the United Kingdom. Browse the entire Double Drip range and find the perfect juice for your e-cigarette setup. Double Drip is available in a variety of formulations to suit a range of kits, including sub ohm (high-VG), 50/50 e-liquid , nicotine salt vape juice , and 50ml shortfills for use with starter vape kits , high-powered e cig kits, compact pod vape kits and pen vape kits .
